design_overview: A clean, modern task management application designed for clarity and efficiency. The interface prioritizes quick task creation, easy status management, and clear visual separation between active and completed tasks. The design uses a card-based layout with strong visual hierarchy, ensuring primary actions are immediately accessible while maintaining a calm, focused user experience suitable for daily productivity.

screens.name: Task List Home
screens.purpose: Primary screen displaying all tasks with filtering options and quick access to task creation

key_components.name: App Header
key_components.styling: White background with subtle bottom border, 64px height, contains app title 'My Tasks' in bold 28px text and user profile icon on right
key_components.interaction: Static header, profile icon navigates to Profile screen

key_components.name: Filter Tabs
key_components.styling: Horizontal tab bar with three options: All, Active, Completed. Active tab has primary color underline and bold text. 48px height with 16px padding
key_components.interaction: Tapping each tab filters the task list below to show corresponding tasks

key_components.name: Task Count Badge
key_components.styling: Light gray text showing '12 tasks' below filter tabs, 14px font size, 8px top margin
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, updates dynamically based on filter selection

key_components.name: Task Card - Active
key_components.styling: White card with 12px rounded corners, 16px padding, subtle shadow. Contains task title in bold 16px, description in 14px gray text below, checkbox on left, edit icon on right. 80px min height
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Task Detail screen. Checkbox marks task complete. Edit icon opens edit mode

key_components.name: Task Card - Completed
key_components.styling: White card with 12px rounded corners, 16px padding, subtle shadow. Title has strikethrough styling, lighter gray text. Green checkmark icon on left. Trash icon on right. 80px min height
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Task Detail screen. Trash icon triggers delete confirmation modal

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered content with light gray illustration placeholder, 'No tasks yet' heading in 20px, 'Create your first task to get started' subtext in 14px gray. 200px height
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive visual feedback when no tasks exist

key_components.name: Task List Container
key_components.styling: Scrollable vertical list with 12px spacing between cards, 16px horizontal padding, fills available screen height below tabs
key_components.interaction: Scrollable list containing task cards, supports pull-to-refresh gesture

key_components.name: Create Task FAB
key_components.styling: Circular floating action button, 56px diameter, primary color background with white plus icon, positioned 24px from bottom-right corner, elevated shadow
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens Create Task modal overlay

key_components.name: Bottom Safe Area
key_components.styling: 24px bottom padding to ensure FAB doesn't overlap content
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive spacing element

screens.user_flow: Entry point of the app after login. Users can view all tasks, filter by status, tap cards to view details, or tap FAB to create new tasks. Navigates to Task Detail, Create Task, or Profile screens.

screens.name: Create Task Modal
screens.purpose: Overlay modal for creating new tasks with title and optional description

key_components.name: Modal Header
key_components.styling: White background, 56px height, 'New Task' title centered in bold 20px, close icon on left, 16px padding
key_components.interaction: Close icon dismisses modal and returns to Task List

key_components.name: Task Title Input
key_components.styling: Single-line text input with light gray border, 12px rounded corners, 16px padding, 48px height. Placeholder: 'Task title (required)'
key_components.interaction: Tapping focuses input and shows keyboard. Required field with validation

key_components.name: Task Description Input
key_components.styling: Multi-line text area with light gray border, 12px rounded corners, 16px padding, 120px height. Placeholder: 'Add description (optional)'
key_components.interaction: Tapping focuses input and shows keyboard. Optional field

key_components.name: Character Count
key_components.styling: Light gray text showing '0/500' below description input, 14px font, right-aligned
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, updates as user types in description

key_components.name: Error Message
key_components.styling: Red error text 'Title is required' shown below title input when validation fails, 14px font
key_components.interaction: Appears when user attempts to submit without title

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.styling: Secondary button with light gray background, dark text, 48px height, 12px rounded corners, 16px horizontal padding
key_components.interaction: Dismisses modal without saving, returns to Task List

key_components.name: Create Button
key_components.styling: Primary button with primary color background, white text, 48px height, 12px rounded corners, 16px horizontal padding, disabled state when title empty
key_components.interaction: Validates input, creates task, shows success feedback, closes modal and returns to Task List with new task visible

key_components.name: Button Container
key_components.styling: Horizontal flex container with 12px gap between buttons, 24px padding, white background with top border
key_components.interaction: Contains Cancel and Create buttons in horizontal layout

key_components.name: Modal Backdrop
key_components.styling: Semi-transparent dark overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) covering entire screen behind modal
key_components.interaction: Tapping backdrop dismisses modal

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Task List via FAB. Users enter task details and submit to create. Returns to Task List on success or cancel.

screens.name: Task Detail Screen
screens.purpose: Full-screen view of a single task with complete information and action options

key_components.name: Navigation Header
key_components.styling: White background, 56px height, back arrow on left, 'Task Details' title centered in bold 20px, edit icon on right
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to Task List. Edit icon enables inline editing mode

key_components.name: Task Title Display
key_components.styling: Bold 24px text, dark color, 24px top padding, 16px horizontal padding, line-height 1.3
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive in view mode, becomes editable input in edit mode

key_components.name: Task Metadata
key_components.styling: Light gray text showing 'Created 2 days ago' in 14px, 8px top margin, 16px horizontal padding
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive timestamp information

key_components.name: Description Section
key_components.styling: White card with light gray background, 12px rounded corners, 16px padding, 24px top margin. Contains 'Description' label in bold 16px and description text in 16px below
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive in view mode, becomes editable textarea in edit mode

key_components.name: Status Section
key_components.styling: White card with light gray background, 12px rounded corners, 16px padding, 16px top margin. Shows status badge (Active/Completed) with appropriate color
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive display of current task status

key_components.name: Mark Complete Button
key_components.styling: Full-width button with success color background, white text, 52px height, 12px rounded corners, 16px margin. Shows checkmark icon and 'Mark as Complete' text
key_components.interaction: Marks task as completed, updates status, shows success toast, updates UI to show completed state

key_components.name: Delete Button
key_components.styling: Full-width button with error color background, white text, 52px height, 12px rounded corners, 16px margin, 8px top spacing. Shows trash icon and 'Delete Task' text
key_components.interaction: Opens delete confirmation modal

key_components.name: Completed Badge
key_components.styling: Green pill-shaped badge with 'Completed' text, 8px padding, 16px rounded corners, shown when task is completed
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive status indicator

key_components.name: Action Container
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom container with white background, 24px padding, subtle top border, contains action buttons
key_components.interaction: Container for primary action buttons

screens.user_flow: Accessed by tapping task cards from Task List. Users can view full details, mark complete, edit, or delete. Returns to Task List via back button or after actions.

screens.name: Delete Confirmation Modal
screens.purpose: Confirmation dialog to prevent accidental task deletion

key_components.name: Modal Container
key_components.styling: White rounded card, 16px rounded corners, 24px padding, centered on screen, max-width 320px, elevated shadow
key_components.interaction: Contains confirmation dialog content

key_components.name: Warning Icon
key_components.styling: Error color circular icon, 48px size, centered, contains alert symbol
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive visual indicator of destructive action

key_components.name: Confirmation Title
key_components.styling: Bold 20px text 'Delete Task?' centered, 16px top margin, dark color
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive heading

key_components.name: Confirmation Message
key_components.styling: 16px gray text 'This action cannot be undone. Are you sure you want to delete this task?' centered, 12px top margin, line-height 1.5
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive description text

key_components.name: Task Title Preview
key_components.styling: Light gray background, 12px padding, 8px rounded corners, 14px text showing task title being deleted, 16px top margin
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive preview of task being deleted

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.styling: Secondary button with light gray background, dark text, 48px height, 12px rounded corners, 24px top margin
key_components.interaction: Dismisses modal without deleting, returns to Task Detail screen

key_components.name: Confirm Delete Button
key_components.styling: Destructive button with error color background, white text, 48px height, 12px rounded corners, 8px top spacing
key_components.interaction: Permanently deletes task, shows success toast, navigates back to Task List

key_components.name: Modal Backdrop
key_components.styling: Semi-transparent dark overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) covering entire screen
key_components.interaction: Tapping backdrop dismisses modal without deleting

screens.user_flow: Triggered from Task Detail or Task List when user attempts to delete. Requires explicit confirmation before deletion. Returns to previous screen on cancel or Task List on confirm.

screens.name: Profile Screen
screens.purpose: User account information and settings management

key_components.name: Profile Header
key_components.styling: White background, 56px height, back arrow on left, 'Profile' title centered in bold 20px
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to Task List

key_components.name: User Avatar
key_components.styling: Circular avatar, 96px diameter, centered, 32px top margin, primary color background with white initials if no photo
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive user profile image

key_components.name: User Name
key_components.styling: Bold 24px text centered, 16px top margin, dark color
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive display of user's full name

key_components.name: User Email
key_components.styling: 16px gray text centered, 4px top margin
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive display of user's email

key_components.name: Statistics Card
key_components.styling: White card with light border, 12px rounded corners, 16px padding, 32px top margin. Contains three columns showing Total Tasks, Active, Completed with numbers in bold 24px and labels in 14px gray
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive statistics display

key_components.name: Settings Section
key_components.styling: White background, 24px top margin, contains list items with icons, labels, and chevron indicators
key_components.interaction: Container for settings options

key_components.name: Account Settings Item
key_components.styling: 56px height, 16px horizontal padding, settings icon on left, 'Account Settings' text in 16px, chevron on right, bottom border
key_components.interaction: Taps navigate to account settings (future feature)

key_components.name: Logout Button
key_components.styling: Full-width button with error color background, white text, 52px height, 12px rounded corners, 24px margin
key_components.interaction: Logs user out and returns to login screen

key_components.name: App Version
key_components.styling: Light gray text 'Version 1.0.0' centered, 14px font, 16px bottom padding
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive version information

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Task List header. Users view account info, statistics, and can logout. Returns to Task List via back button.

ui_components.styling: Primary color background, white text, 48px height, 12px rounded corners, 16px horizontal padding, bold font, subtle shadow on press
ui_components.interaction: Triggers primary actions, shows pressed state, may show loading spinner

ui_components.name: Secondary Button
ui_components.styling: Light gray background, dark text, 48px height, 12px rounded corners, 16px horizontal padding, medium font weight
ui_components.interaction: Triggers secondary or cancel actions, shows pressed state

ui_components.name: Text Input
ui_components.styling: Light gray border, 12px rounded corners, 16px padding, 48px height, focus state shows primary color border
ui_components.interaction: Accepts text input, shows keyboard on focus, displays validation errors below

ui_components.name: Checkbox
ui_components.styling: 24px square with 4px rounded corners, light gray border, primary color when checked with white checkmark
ui_components.interaction: Toggles between checked and unchecked states

ui_components.name: Task Card
ui_components.styling: White background, 12px rounded corners, 16px padding, subtle shadow, bottom border, tap highlight on press
ui_components.interaction: Tappable card that navigates to detail view or triggers actions

ui_components.name: Toast Notification
ui_components.styling: Dark background (rgba(0,0,0,0.9)), white text, 16px rounded corners, 16px padding, slides up from bottom, auto-dismisses after 3s

ui_components.name: Loading Spinner
ui_components.styling: Primary color circular spinner, 32px diameter, centered in container

ui_components.name: Icon Button

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices. Layouts use flexible containers with percentage-based widths and max-width constraints. Touch targets minimum 44x44px. Content scales appropriately on tablets with max-width 768px centered. Supports both portrait and landscape orientations with adjusted layouts. Safe area insets respected for notched devices.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 for text. Form inputs include proper labels and error messages. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Keyboard navigation supported for web version. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Error states communicated through color, icons, and text.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability without distraction. Button press states use 150ms scale transform. Modal overlays fade in over 200ms with slide-up animation. List items use staggered fade-in on load. Task completion shows checkmark animation with success color pulse. Page transitions use 300ms slide animations. Loading states show smooth spinner rotation. Toast notifications slide up with 250ms ease-out timing.
icons: Consistent icon set using outline style for visual clarity. Icons sized 20-24px for optimal touch and visibility. Primary icons: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person outline), settings (gear), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (like), filter (funnel), plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (bin), share (arrow), check (checkmark), close (X). All icons use 2px stroke width for consistency.
